user.title: TomTom API key
user.description: RavitBornes uses your own TomTom API key to look up charging stations and their availability. Create a free key at my.tomtom.com.

data_description.api_key: Stored in Home Assistant only, never logged.

settings.title: Vehicle and position
settings.description: Choose where the car's position comes from, how a trip is detected and which connectors the car accepts.

data_description.position_entities: Phone and/or car trackers. The most recently updated one is used. Nothing is looked up while it is at home.
data_description.trip_entity: For example the companion app's Android Auto sensor. While it is on, availability is refreshed every 3 minutes, even when the car is stopped; while it is off, nothing is looked up automatically (the "Search stations (30 min)" button still works).
data_description.connectors: Only stations with at least one of these connectors are shown.
data_description.profile: Highway: fast DC charging close to the road. Visit: any charger close to where you stop.

error.quota_exceeded: The TomTom quota or rate limit is reached. Try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach TomTom. Check the connection and try again.
error.no_position: Select at least one position source.
